description: Move the web-only pure view helpers (formatInr/formatDate/formatDateTime, pickAttr, price-breakup view, order-view logic, home defaults) verbatim into @belzo/shared and turn the web modules into thin re-exports so every web import path and behaviour stays identical (design.md §10). Depends on FEAT-001 only in that both edit packages/shared/src/index.ts; mobile (FEAT-004/005) consumes these exports.
steps: plan.md item 10: create packages/shared/src/format.ts (formatInr from apps/web/src/lib/format-inr.ts; formatDate, formatDateTime from apps/web/src/lib/order-view.ts), attributes.ts (pickAttr from apps/web/src/lib/variant-edit.ts), price-breakup.ts (all of apps/web/src/lib/price-breakup.ts), order-view.ts (rest of apps/web/src/lib/order-view.ts importing ./format, ./attributes, ./price-breakup and sibling shared modules relatively — never '@belzo/shared'), home.ts (DEFAULT_SECTIONS, sanitizeHomeSections, getHomeSections from home-sections.ts; ThemeName, DEFAULT_HOME_EMART, DEFAULT_HOME_CLASSIC, mergeHome + private DEFAULTS from site-content.ts). Export lists exactly as the design §10 table. Add the five `export *` lines to packages/shared/src/index.ts.

`git mv` apps/web/src/lib/format-inr.test.ts → packages/shared/src/format.test.ts, price-breakup.test.ts → packages/shared/src/price-breakup.test.ts, order-view.test.ts → packages/shared/src/order-view.test.ts; rewrite only the import lines to relative shared paths; in order-view.test.ts add the non-null assertions at lines 147 (steps[0]!.at), 152 (withInvoice[1]!.at), 170 (steps[2]!.at) and 250 (makeOrder({ items: [{ ...base.items[0]!, isReturnable: false }, base.items[1]!] })). No asserted value changes.

plan.md item 11: rewrite apps/web/src/lib/format-inr.ts, price-breakup.ts, order-view.ts (explicit named re-export list with `type` modifiers for types PLUS `export { formatDate, formatDateTime } from '@belzo/shared'` — order-sections.tsx imports them from @/lib/order-view), variant-edit.ts (remove local pickAttr, import it from shared and keep `export { pickAttr }`), home-sections.ts (re-export the three moved symbols; keep resolveHomeSections, ResolvedSection, category flattening), site-content.ts (re-export the four moved symbols; keep FooterContent, DEFAULT_FOOTER, DEFAULT_HOME alias, SiteContent, getSiteContent).

Run `pnpm --filter @belzo/shared build` (api compiles against dist), then the verification commands; commit `feat(shared): shared view helpers (formatInr, price breakup, order view, home defaults); web re-exports` adding files explicitly (include the git mv renames).
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm --filter @belzo/shared test` passes including the three moved test files; `typecheck`, `lint`, `build` pass
`pnpm --filter @belzo/web typecheck`, `test`, `lint`, `build` pass with site-content.test.ts and variant-edit.test.ts unmodified
`git diff HEAD~1 --stat -- apps/web/src/app` is empty (no page/component edits)
verification: pnpm --filter @belzo/shared test; pnpm --filter @belzo/shared typecheck; pnpm --filter @belzo/shared lint; pnpm --filter @belzo/shared build
pnpm --filter @belzo/web typecheck; pnpm --filter @belzo/web test; pnpm --filter @belzo/web lint; pnpm --filter @belzo/web build
git diff HEAD~1 --stat -- apps/web/src/app  (expect no output)
findings: COMMIT (master, local, not pushed): 8dfa5b7 feat(shared): shared view helpers (formatInr, price breakup, order view, home defaults); web re-exports. 15 paths: new packages/shared/src/{format,attributes,price-breakup,order-view,home}.ts; packages/shared/src/index.ts (+5 export * lines); git mv renames (R) apps/web/src/lib/format-inr.test.ts -> packages/shared/src/format.test.ts, price-breakup.test.ts -> packages/shared/src/price-breakup.test.ts, order-view.test.ts -> packages/shared/src/order-view.test.ts; web lib re-exports format-inr.ts, price-breakup.ts, order-view.ts, variant-edit.ts, home-sections.ts, site-content.ts. Moved code verified byte-verbatim against HEAD~1 sources (script check, incl. emoji/unicode). Shared modules import siblings relatively (./constants, ./order-tracking, ./orders, ./returns, ./pricing, ./schemas, ./format, ./attributes, ./price-breakup), never '@belzo/shared'. Moved tests: only import lines rewritten to relative paths (order-view.test.ts line 1 split into 3 imports from ./constants, ./order-tracking, ./returns; price-breakup.test.ts line 1 split into ./money + ./pricing) plus the 4 design-listed non-null assertions (steps[0]!.at, withInvoice[1]!.at, steps[2]!.at, base.items[0]!/base.items[1]!); no asserted values changed. VERIFICATION (all exit 0): shared test 14 suites / 258 tests (was 221; +37 moved), typecheck, lint, build; web typecheck, test 6 suites / 95 tests (was 9/132; the 3 moved suites now run in shared; site-content.test.ts and variant-edit.test.ts unmodified and green), lint (pre-existing warnings only), build; api typecheck, test 37 suites / 373 tests; `git diff HEAD~1 --stat -- apps/web/src/app` empty. FINAL SHARED EXPORTS ADDED (@belzo/shared): format.ts: formatInr, formatDate, formatDateTime; attributes.ts: pickAttr; price-breakup.ts: OrderMoneySnapshot (type), snapshotFromBreakup, BreakupRow (type), BreakupView (type), breakupView; order-view.ts: types OrderAddress, OrderDetailItem, OrderPayment, ReturnStatus, ReturnResolution, OrderReturn, OrderDetail, Tone, StepState, Step, PaymentSummary, ReturnItemEligibility, ReturnEligibility, ResolutionOption, ReturnDraft, ReturnPayload; values shortOrderId, statusBadge, isLiveStatus, buildStepper, paymentSummary, refundNote, cancelEligibility, cancelUnavailableReason, commentMaxChars, cancelReasonError, cancelReasonText, returnEligibility, photosRequired, resolutionOptions, RETURN_STEPS, returnStepError, buildReturnPayload, returnStatusLabel, returnStatusTone, resolutionLabel, variantText; home.ts: DEFAULT_SECTIONS, sanitizeHomeSections, getHomeSections, ThemeName (type), DEFAULT_HOME_EMART, DEFAULT_HOME_CLASSIC, mergeHome (DEFAULTS stays private). NOTES: shared/src/order-view.ts imports ./orders and price-breakup.test.ts imports ./money, which are pre-existing UNTRACKED shared files (as are money/catalogue/wallet/reporting, shared package.json, tsconfig.json, jest.config.js — index.ts already referenced them before this FEAT); left untracked per the 'no unrelated untracked files' rule, so a clean checkout of master alone would not build shared — owner should track the shared package files separately. packages/shared/dist rebuilt (gitignored). No deviations from design §10.
